tools.name: get_monetization_requirements
tools.description: FACT. Use this first when you need Snap's published creator-monetization rules themselves: thresholds, country lists, policy text, source URL, verified_at, and effective date. Do not use it to score one creator or to compute a shortfall. For a creator's numbers, use check_eligibility or calculate_ga

tools.name: get_rule_changes
tools.description: FACT. Use this when you need what changed in Snap's monetization rules since a date: previous value, new value, source, and the date we detected the change. Do not use it for the current rule list (get_monetization_requirements) or for a creator's gap (calculate_gap). When a response includes an upg

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: CALCULATION. Use this to compare one creator's caller-supplied metrics with the published entry requirements. Returns published_criteria_status of meets_published_criteria, does_not_meet_published_criteria, or unknown, plus pass/fail/unknown per requirement. Do not use it when you need the numeric s

tools.name: calculate_gap
tools.description: CALCULATION. Use this when you need the exact numeric shortfall, percent complete, and binding constraint for a creator's caller-supplied metrics. Do not use it for the pace to close that gap (calculate_growth_pace) or for a per-requirement pass/fail list (check_eligibility). Access: needs a free de

tools.name: calculate_growth_pace
tools.description: CALCULATION. Use this when you need the daily and weekly pace to close each numeric gap within target_days, with scenarios and labeled assumptions. This is a projection, not a prediction. Do not use it to learn the size of the gap (calculate_gap) or to list the rules (get_monetization_requirements).

tools.name: calculate_payout_timeline
tools.description: CALCULATION. Use this when you need a date-by-date timeline of Snap's payout steps from a credited date: Pending to Available, the cash-out minimum, taxpayer verification, and the earliest day cash can reach the Payout Portal. Ranges stay ranges when the source gives a range. This is an estimate, no

tools.name: watch_save_checkin
tools.description: WRITE. Save caller-supplied Snapchat numbers on this key's Eligibility Watch. A field you include replaces that date. A field you omit keeps the saved value. Null clears it. Access: needs a creator trial or paid plan.

tools.name: watch_get_status
tools.description: READ. Return this key's Eligibility Watch trend, projected dates, and rule-change notes. It does not write. Access: needs a creator trial or paid plan.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_monetization_requirements" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
